code_text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, o.order_id, r.risk_tier FROM `acme-lakehouse-raw.bronze_erp_customers.raw_customers` c LEFT JOIN `acme-dwh-prod.silver_orders_cleansed.orders_v2` o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN `acme-lakehouse-raw.bronze_risk_lake.country_risk_matrix` r ON c.country_code = r.country_iso

views.country_risk_matrix: SELECT iso_code, risk_level AS risk_tier FROM ext_risk_geography WHERE active = 1
